# Journal — job S3a (WebKit site rebuild)

- 14:48 Started. Scaffolding Vite + Vue 3 + TS app.
- 14:50 **Setup** — `npm create vite@latest app -- --template vue-ts`, then `npm install ../pkgs/*.tgz vue-router`. Ran `npx @aziontech/webkit init --dry-run` then `init --yes`: it wrote `src/webkit.css` (@import '@aziontech/theme' + '@aziontech/webkit/styles'), patched `src/main.ts`, added eslint/stylelint/husky/tailwind devDeps, `postcss.config.mjs`, `.mcp.json`, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and .claude/ skills+rules. Worked well: one command, clear plan, never clobbered files.
- 14:52 **medium — theme version mismatch.** `@aziontech/webkit@5.12.0` depends on `@aziontech/theme ^4.0.0`, but the job ships `theme 5.2.2`. npm therefore installs a *second* nested copy (`node_modules/@aziontech/webkit/node_modules/@aziontech/theme` = 4.3.1). The app imports 5.2.2 via webkit.css while WebKit internals may resolve 4.3.1. Nothing in README/MIGRATION-v6.md says which theme major pairs with webkit 5.12. I kept both (no visible breakage in screenshots). ~3 min.
- 14:53 **low — init's dark-mode note.** `init` says "the design system defaults to LIGHT. For dark mode set <html data-theme=\"dark\">". Clear and enough: I set `data-theme="dark" class="dark"` on <html> in index.html; site is dark-only.
- 14:55 **medium — `vue-tsc -b` (the Vite template's build script) cannot resolve any `@aziontech/webkit/<name>` subpath** (TS2307 for every import), while `vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` resolves them all fine. README only says "TypeScript (optional) … add vueCompilerOptions.htmlAttributes". Changed the build script to `vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build`. Also `@aziontech/icons` has no types, so the side-effect import `import '@aziontech/icons'` that `init` writes into main.ts fails `vue-tsc` (TS2882); added `declare module '@aziontech/icons'` in src/env.d.ts. ~8 min.
- 14:58 **Discovery worked well.** `llms/llms.txt` has a "Components: Marketing sections" list that maps almost 1:1 onto the azion.com product template: HeroBand (kind=centered), CapabilityGrid, ClientQuotes, MediaSplitStack (kind=alternating), UseCaseLinks, PlatformDirectory, FaqSection, ClosingCallToAction (kind=split), SiteNav, SiteFooter, SectionContainer max-width=site + SectionGap hatch. rules/webkit-sections.md explains the page shell clearly. `npx @aziontech/webkit search product page` was much less useful: it returned console blocks (analytics dashboard, auth) and never named the marketing sections.
- 15:00 **medium — two competing shell recipes.** `shells/website` block (`npx @aziontech/webkit view shells/website`) builds the chrome from GlobalHeader + NavigationMenu + SearchTrigger + Command + Footer by hand, while llms.txt also offers SiteNav / SiteFooter sections "for every marketing page". Nothing says which one wins. I used SiteNav + SiteFooter (data-driven, matches the reference's mega-menus/mobile sheet) and HeroBand instead of the block's Hero.
- 15:01 **medium — SiteNav's search is a dead IconButton.** site-nav.vue renders `<IconButton icon="pi pi-search">` with no emit/handler, and SiteNav has no event or slot for it — contradicting rules/webkit-header-search.md ("never a bare magnifier IconButton", must be SearchTrigger + Command). Can't open a palette without rebuilding the nav. Left as is.
- 15:02 **low — SiteNav shows Login on iPhone**; reference hides it below sm (only hamburger, wordmark, Start for free, search). No prop to hide it.
- 15:04 **medium — images/logos for sections.** ClientQuotes takes `mark` (registry name, one-ink) or `logo` (a URL). The registry names are not listed in any doc — I found them by reading `src/svg/brands/registry.ts` (agibank … gpa, axur, herospark, contabilizei, global-fashion-group; no zoop). Zoop and the colour GPA logo (reference shows GPA in its blue) need a URL, but the SVGs inside the package are not exported (`src/assets/…` is a forbidden deep import), so I copied `zoop-extended-color.svg` and `gpa-extended-color.svg` into `public/logos/`. ~6 min.
- 15:05 **low — illustration names undocumented.** `Illustration`/MediaSplitStack `illustration` takes a "registry name" but the docs never list them; found by `ls src/assets/illustrations`. Happily it has exact matches for Bot Manager: detect-and-classify, intent-to-policy, mitigation-actions, reputation-intelligence-for-enhanced-protection.
- 15:06 **low — ClientQuotes autoplay can't be turned off.** QuoteTabs has `autoplay`/`autoplayInterval` but ClientQuotes doesn't forward them, so the shot can land on any tab (first shot caught AXUR; the reference caught GPA).
- 15:07 **low — HeroBand height.** `kind="centered"` fills a full screen; reference fills screen minus the 56px nav. `headerOffset` exists but takes "any CSS length" and no token exists for the header height (GlobalHeader uses Tailwind `h-14`). Used `header-offset="3.5rem"`.
- 15:08 **low — FAQ answers.** pages.json only has the questions (captured closed); FaqSection needs answers, so I wrote short mock answers.
- 15:09 **site-product-bot-manager built** — first shot already very close to the reference on desktop and iPhone (~20 min total including docs reading). Hero, capability grid, quote tabs, alternating media stack, use-case links, directory, FAQ, split CTA, footer all from WebKit sections.
- 15:20 **high — Illustration registry silently falls back to a placeholder.** `illustration: 'ddos-protection'` (an SVG that *ships* in `src/assets/illustrations/ddos-protection.svg`) rendered a blue "PLACE DESIGN ASSET" box in MediaSplitStack. Cause: 11 shipped SVGs (ddos-protection, ai-gateway, azion-highlight, azion-rest-api, branches, distributed-apis-tile, personal-tokens, real-time-metrics-*, usage-chart) are not in `registry.ts`, and an unknown name loads `placeholder.svg` with no console warning. No doc lists valid names, so the only way to find out is a screenshot. Used `automate-threat-mitigation` instead. ~6 min.
- 15:21 **medium — no illustration matches most reference scenes.** The reference's media rows are bespoke product diagrams (DNSSEC chain of trust, weighted policy, ANAME zone, LB failover with Google Cloud/AWS/Azure). WebKit's illustration set has close matches for Bot Manager and Network Shield only; for Edge DNS and Load Balancer I picked the nearest generic scenes (dns-protection, automate-threat-mitigation, improve-application-performance-and-reliability, fastest-path-to-live-website, low-latency, global-network). The `src/assets/diagrams/` folder has edge-dns.ts / load-balancer.ts / network-shield.ts, but they only feed ArchitectureTabs/Diagram, not MediaSplitStack's `illustration`.
- 15:22 **network-shield, edge-dns built** — same section set as Bot Manager (Network Shield has no use-case/directory band; Edge DNS puts the media stack before the quotes, as the reference does).
- 15:24 **medium — "industries" carousel (Load Balancer) only approximable.** Built from SectionModule (header slot → SectionTitle kind=left size=small padding=small) + Carousel/CarouselItem/CarouselPrevious/CarouselNext + Link. Gaps: (1) Carousel always draws its controls *above* the track on the left; the reference puts them at the far end of the title row, and they can't move outside Carousel because they read its context; (2) cards sit edge-to-edge sharing hairlines, the reference has gutters and rounded cards; (3) `Link` is blue sans "See solution"; the reference is an orange-arrow mono uppercase "SEE SOLUTION" link — no Link kind for it. No marketing section in llms.txt covers "titled carousel of linked cards". ~10 min.
- 15:25 **low — HeroBand `titleLength`.** `title-length="long"` widened the Load Balancer H1 to 2 lines; the reference is 3 lines, so the default `short` is right. Fine once tried.
- 15:30 **medium — WebKit's own Carousel example fails WebKit's lint.** llms/components/carousel.md shows `<CarouselItem class="w-[85vw] max-w-120 sm:w-120">`; `webkit/no-style-override` rejects `w-[85vw] sm:w-120` on that tag. CarouselItem "takes its width from the consumer" but the lint allows only w-full/max-w-*/self-*/shrink-0, so the width cannot be set on the item. Workaround: the width classes go on a div inside the item. Lint also wanted `@aziontech/webkit/carousel-root` instead of `/carousel` (the docs example imports `/carousel`). ~5 min.
- 15:31 **low — the comment lint is strict.** `webkit/authoring-standards` rejects every non-JSDoc comment, including a `/// <reference types="vite/client" />` triple-slash directive (it counts as a "prose comment"). I removed my data comments; the rationale lives in this journal instead.
- 15:32 **low — init vs doctor disagree.** `init` writes eight devDependencies as `"latest"`; `webkit check`/`doctor` then warns "pinned as latest, consider pinning". Pinned them to the installed versions → `webkit check`: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- 15:33 **medium — husky pre-commit, then a broken hook.** `init` adds husky + `.husky/pre-commit` (`npx eslint .` + stylelint). It only activates when `npm install` runs again after `git init` (my first commits ran without it). Once active, it failed the commit: the eslint.config.mjs that `init` generates has no `ignores`, so `eslint .` lints the built `dist/` bundle (50 errors: hex colours inside WebKit's own compiled scene/theme code), plus the Vite template's comment in vite.config.ts. Fixed by adding `{ ignores: ["dist/**", "node_modules/**"] }` to eslint.config.mjs, a `.stylelintignore` (stylelint had the same problem with dist/*.css), and deleting the comment. ~8 min.
- 15:35 Final: `npm run build` passes; `npx eslint src`, `npx stylelint`, `vue-tsc` and `npx @aziontech/webkit check` are clean. All four pages shot at the end (desktop + iPhone); no console errors. Heights vs reference: bot-manager 7874/8296, network-shield 6388/6790, edge-dns 7050/7285, load-balancer 7479/7661 (desktop). Static SPA fallback checked with `vite preview` (/, deep link and unknown path all serve index.html). Note: my first fallback check accidentally hit port 5122, which belongs to another job's dev server (strictPort failed silently in the background); I re-ran it on a free port and killed only my own processes by PID.

# DONE — job S3a

## Pages
- `site-product-bot-manager`: **built**. Every band from WebKit sections. Small differences: FAQ answers are mock copy (only the questions are in pages.json); ClientQuotes autoplays, so a shot can land on any client tab; non-GPA quote texts come from WebKit's own examples; search icon in the nav opens nothing; iPhone nav also shows Login.
- `site-product-network-shield`: **built**. Same caveats. The media-row illustrations are WebKit's nearest scenes (network-lists-rules-engine, custom-allowed-rules, stream-security-events…, programmable-security), not the reference's Console screenshots.
- `site-product-edge-dns`: **built**. Media-row illustrations are only approximations: there is no DNSSEC chain-of-trust, weighted-policy or ANAME scene in WebKit, and `ddos-protection` renders a placeholder (see problem 1).
- `site-product-load-balancer`: **partial**. Everything is built. The "Optimize traffic distribution across industries" carousel is approximated: the controls sit above the track instead of in the title row, the cards share edges instead of having gutters, and the link is a blue "See solution" instead of the orange mono "SEE SOLUTION →". The media-row illustrations are generic.
- `/` lists links to all four pages; router uses history mode; site is dark-only (`<html data-theme="dark" class="dark">`).

## WebKit pieces used most
SectionContainer (max-width=site) + SectionGap (hatch), HeroBand (kind=centered, header-offset), CapabilityGrid, ClientQuotes, MediaSplitStack (kind=alternating, `illustration`), PlatformDirectory, FaqSection, ClosingCallToAction (kind=split), SiteNav, SiteFooter, WebkitProvider, UseCaseLinks, SectionModule + SectionTitle, Carousel(-root/-item/-previous/-next), Link; `@aziontech/icons` (pi-* and ai-* classes); the `init`/`view`/`check` CLI and llms/llms.txt.

## Top 5 problems with WebKit (by impact)
1. **The illustration registry fails silently and is undocumented.** Valid names are not listed anywhere. 11 SVGs that ship in the package (e.g. `ddos-protection`) are not registered, so they render a "PLACE DESIGN ASSET" placeholder with no warning. On top of that, most product-page scenes in the reference have no WebKit illustration at all.
2. **Brand-mark and logo assets are hard to reach.** ClientQuotes `mark` names are undocumented (found in src/svg/brands/registry.ts). Colour logos (GPA in its blue, Zoop) exist only as unexported files under src/assets, which is a forbidden deep import, so I had to copy them into public/.
3. **Shell guidance contradicts itself, and the header rule can't be met.** `shells/website` hand-builds GlobalHeader+SearchTrigger+Command, while the SiteNav/SiteFooter sections are the data-driven way. SiteNav's search is a bare `pi-search` IconButton with no event, which violates WebKit's own `webkit-header-search` rule and can't be wired to a Command palette.
4. **Docs, lint and setup disagree.** The Carousel docs example fails `no-style-override` and `prefer-tree-shakeable-root`. `init` writes `"latest"` deps that `doctor` then warns about, and adds a husky pre-commit hook whose `eslint .` / stylelint also lint the built `dist/` (the eslint config that `init` generates has no ignores), so the first build blocks every commit. The template's `vue-tsc -b` cannot resolve any webkit subpath (`-p tsconfig.app.json` can), and `@aziontech/icons` has no types for the import `init` adds. webkit 5.12 also depends on theme ^4 while theme 5.2.2 is shipped, which gives two theme copies.
5. **Some sections are missing knobs the site needs.** ClientQuotes doesn't forward QuoteTabs' `autoplay`. SiteNav can't hide Login on mobile. No marketing section covers a "titled carousel of linked cards" (Load Balancer industries). Carousel controls can't sit in the section's title row. There is no header-height token for HeroBand `headerOffset`.

## Build
`npm run build` (now `vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build`) **passes** and produces `app/dist/`, which works as a static SPA (unknown paths fall back to index.html). eslint, stylelint and `npx @aziontech/webkit check` all report 0 errors and 0 warnings. Dev server stopped.
